entities.summary: The Great Mosque of Nedroma, commonly known as the Great Mosque, is a mosque in the city of Nedroma, situated approximately 77 kilometres (48 mi) from the city of Tlemcen, in the Tlemcen Province, in northern Algeria. The mosque was founded in 1145 CE and contains the earliest surviving Almoravid minbar.
